description: DRAFT (2026-10-22). Campaign level 0.1, a copy of the first test map L_MovementTest (the checkpoint, the canister / generator / terminal quest, the blast gate) with the lake's last compound and its open blast door recreated behind the squad's start (set dressing). Started from L_MovementTest's level file (level_01_outpost.json) without the tutorial; ONE small wave only as the minimal valid config (an empty wave list falls back to 10 built-in waves) - the real encounter design is to come.
